data.label: Website Check
data.title:
5 signs your website is
*losing you customers*
data.sub: Swipe to see if yours is guilty →

data.label: Sign #1
data.title: It looks *broken on mobile*
data.body: Most customers search for services on their phones. If your site is hard to navigate, they will leave and call your competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Test your site on a phone and click every button.

data.label: Sign #2
data.title: It takes *too long* to load
data.body: People are impatient. If your site takes more than a few seconds to load, you are losing potential sales every single day.
data.fix: Fix: Compress your large images to make them load faster.

data.label: Sign #3
data.title: Your *contact info* is hidden
data.body: Customers shouldn't have to hunt for your phone number or address. If they can’t find it instantly, they will move on.
data.fix: Fix: Put your phone number in the top right corner.

data.label: Sign #4
data.title: Google can't *find you*
data.body: If your website doesn't mention your city and services clearly, you won't show up when local customers search for help.
data.fix: Fix: Add your city and service names to your homepage.

data.label: Sign #5
data.title: No *clear call* to action
data.body: Don't make customers guess what to do next. They need a clear button telling them to book a job or call.
data.fix: Fix: Add a big 'Call Now' button on every page.
